The *Ekādasamanaya Saṅgahitenasampayuttavippayuttapadaniddesa* ("Exposition of the Eleventh Method: Associated and Dissociated with What is Included") constitutes the eleventh section (Dt 2.11) of the *Dhātukathā*, the third book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As with the other analytical chapters of the work, it applies a specific interrogative method to classify mental and physical phenomena according to their inclusion (*saṅgaha*), association (*sampayoga*), and dissociation (*vippayoga*) within the frameworks of the aggregates, bases, and elements [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one translation of the text in one language [SuttaCentral].
